coverage_gaps: Embase and other subject indexes are unavailable, limiting non-PubMed journal and conference coverage.
Citation-graph and DOI-metadata routes are unavailable, so forward and backward citation expansion must rely on PubMed links and registry publication links.
Non-FDA regulator routes, including EMA and other jurisdictions, are unavailable; regulatory conclusions are limited to FDA actions.
Preprint and general web routes are unavailable, limiting discovery of unpublished analyses and publisher-hosted integrity notices not indexed in PubMed.
The available routes do not independently provide hidden sponsor data, individual-participant data, or adjudication files.
exclusion_criteria: Evidence first made public after 2024-12-31, except when retained solely to identify a later correction or retraction affecting a pre-cutoff record and clearly labeled post-cutoff.
Studies without rheumatoid arthritis data unless they directly underpin an FDA class-wide action or clarify a tofacitinib safety mechanism relevant to the assessed outcomes.
Efficacy-only, pharmacokinetic-only, animal, in vitro, narrative opinion, or promotional records lacking decision-relevant human safety evidence.
Duplicate canonical records after identifier-based merging; preserve every query-to-record occurrence and registry-publication-regulatory link.
Claims based only on abstracts, snippets, or secondary summaries when the underlying primary record is available.
Unverifiable records or records with conflicting identifiers that cannot be resolved; quarantine them rather than admitting them as qualified evidence.
inclusion_criteria: Records available on or before 2024-12-31, with online-first, issue, registry-update, and FDA effective dates recorded separately.
The NCT02092467 registry record, its historical changes, posted results, adverse-event tables, and publication links.
Peer-reviewed primary or secondary analyses directly reporting cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, or mortality outcomes for tofacitinib in rheumatoid arthritis.
FDA safety communications, review materials, boxed-warning or indication changes, and prescribing-information revisions that state the evidence basis and action date.

Comparative randomized or observational evidence capable of qualifying, corroborating, or conflicting with ORAL Surveillance, with population, dose, comparator, follow-up, and adjustment methods extractable.
Corrections, errata, retractions, expressions of concern, or linked notices associated with any decision-critical publication.

queries.purpose: Recover the primary ORAL Surveillance publication through verified locators or its exact title.
queries.query: "35081280"[PMID] OR "10.1056/NEJMoa2109927"[AID] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]

queries.purpose: Recover the pivotal postauthorization study registry record and its results, outcomes, amendments, and linked publications.
Locate FDA materials that explicitly identify the pivotal safety study.
Retrieve peer-reviewed rheumatoid arthritis safety evidence across all decision-critical outcomes without suppressive NOT clauses.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract] OR "CP-690,550"[Title/Abstract]) AND ("Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms] OR "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract]) AND (safety[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Identify registered rheumatoid arthritis studies that can qualify, corroborate, or conflict with the pivotal safety findings.
queries.query: AREA[InterventionName](tofacitinib OR Xeljanz) AND AREA[Condition](rheumatoid arthritis)

queries.purpose: Retrieve FDA safety communications, reviews, labels, and updates spanning the four outcome domains.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz rheumatoid arthritis safety cardiovascular cancer blood clots death

queries.purpose: Confirm cardiovascular estimates, noninferiority interpretation, components, and subgroup qualifications from study-linked publications.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND ("major adverse cardiovascular event"[Title/Abstract] OR MACE[Title/Abstract] OR cardiovascular[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm malignancy findings, latency patterns, cancer types, and risk-factor analyses.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR lymphoma[Title/Abstract] OR "lung cancer"[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Confirm thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, dose-related risk, and mortality findings.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR "pulmonary embolism"[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR death[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Trace FDA conclusions and risk-management actions into communications and marketed-product labeling.
queries.query: tofacitinib Xeljanz "Drug Safety Communication" OR "boxed warning" OR "prescribing information"

queries.purpose: Retrieve linked secondary analyses that identify effect modifiers and delimit generalizability.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (subgroup*[Title/Abstract] OR "risk factor"[Title/Abstract] OR age[Title/Abstract] OR smoking[Title/Abstract] OR dose[Title/Abstract] OR biomarker*[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Find external observational evidence that qualifies, corroborates, or conflicts with ORAL Surveillance.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR Xeljanz[Title/Abstract]) AND ("rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract] OR "Arthritis, Rheumatoid"[MeSH Terms]) AND ("TNF inhibitor"[Title/Abstract] OR adalimumab[Title/Abstract] OR etanercept[Title/Abstract]) AND (cohort[Title/Abstract] OR registry[Title/Abstract] OR observational[Title/Abstract] OR "real world"[Title/Abstract]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Check the primary publication and its locator family for correction, retraction, or expression-of-concern records.
queries.query: ("35081280"[PMID] OR "10.1056/NEJMoa2109927"[AID] OR "Cardiovascular and Cancer Risk with Tofacitinib in Rheumatoid Arthritis"[Title]) AND (Correction[Publication Type] OR Retracted Publication[Publication Type] OR Retraction of Publication[Publication Type] OR correction[Title] OR erratum[Title] OR retraction[Title] OR "expression of concern"[Title])

queries.purpose: Retrieve explicit null, conflicting, or methodological challenge evidence relevant to interpretation.
queries.query: (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] OR "ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract]) AND (null[Title/Abstract] OR negative[Title/Abstract] OR conflicting[Title/Abstract] OR contradiction[Title/Abstract] OR limitation*[Title/Abstract] OR bias[Title/Abstract])

queries.purpose: Recheck registry history, results, status, adverse-event tables, and linked-publication changes through the as-of date.
Capture post-primary-publication safety analyses, counterevidence, and integrity notices through 2024-12-31.
queries.query: ("ORAL Surveillance"[Title/Abstract] OR NCT02092467[Title/Abstract] OR (tofacitinib[Title/Abstract] AND "rheumatoid arthritis"[Title/Abstract])) AND ("2022/01/01"[Date - Publication] : "2024/12/31"[Date - Publication]) AND (cardiovascular[Title/Abstract] OR malignan*[Title/Abstract] OR cancer[Title/Abstract] OR thrombosis[Title/Abstract] OR thromboembol*[Title/Abstract] OR mortality[Title/Abstract] OR correction[Title] OR retraction[Title])

question_frame: Safety PECO as of 2024-12-31: among adults with rheumatoid arthritis aged 50 years or older and at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor, assess marketed tofacitinib versus tumor necrosis factor inhibitors in the pivotal postauthorization ORAL Surveillance study; link the study to its registry record, primary publication, related analyses, and FDA actions; characterize major adverse cardiovascular events, malignancy excluding nonmelanoma skin cancer, venous and arterial thrombosis, pulmonary embolism, and all-cause mortality; identify effect modifiers, methodological qualifications, conflicting evidence, and correction, expression-of-concern, or retraction status relevant to evidence handling.
stop_rules: Complete all 16 planned route-specific query events and document the cutoff, execution timestamp, result count, and provider version when available.
Verify recovery and identity linkage of NCT02092467, the primary publication, and at least one FDA action explicitly tied to the pivotal safety study.
Confirm that cardiovascular, malignancy, thrombosis, and mortality each have a direct-evidence checkpoint and that qualifying or conflicting evidence has been sought.
Complete dedicated correction, retraction, expression-of-concern, null-result, and conflicting-evidence challenge searches.
Stop expansion after two consecutive completed expansion or linked-record passes add no new decision-relevant canonical evidence.
Stop when additional retrieval within the available routes cannot change the safety conclusion or its uncertainty; record unresolved gaps and any query-budget exhaustion.
Fail closed on unresolved identifier conflicts, date conflicts, or material discrepancies between registry, publication, and FDA records until reconciled or explicitly reported.
